limitations: Finite digital wire model; not electrical timing or physical accuracy proof.
Models GPIO start/release and asynchronous finite sampled input; busy GPIO polling does not advance physical time. No register/electrical emulation in device scoring.
Bounded capture completion delays, cancellation and wire pulse variations; not all scheduler interleavings.
Corrupt-frame numeric success is a core integrity failure; optional fault recovery is diagnostic. Humidity HIL cannot represent an asynchronous error.
The documented previous measurement semantics permits bounded caching; stable changed stimuli must eventually be observed.
